entries.name: Microsoft Playwright MCP
entries.securityNotes: Official Microsoft browser automation MCP via accessibility snapshots; run only against localhost or approved test targets.

entries.name: Microsoft PostgreSQL MCP
entries.securityNotes: Official Microsoft Postgres MCP supporting read-only modes and OS keyring credentials; restrict to local/dev DBs in autonomous mode.

entries.name: Supabase Official MCP Server
entries.securityNotes: Official Supabase MCP; scope access tokens to dev/staging projects and require Red-Zone approval before schema mutations.

entries.name: Semgrep Built-in MCP Server
entries.securityNotes: Official SAST MCP bundled directly inside the Semgrep CLI binary; scans local workspace code for OWASP/injection/secret bugs.

entries.name: FFmpeg MCP Server
entries.securityNotes: Community Node.js MCP bundling ffmpeg-static with workspace directory constraints; inspect package version and keep inputs/ read-only.

entries.name: Mnehmos FFmpeg Timeline MCP
entries.securityNotes: TypeScript MCP compiling JSON timeline graphs into FFmpeg filter_complex pipelines; clone and audit before enabling locally.

entries.name: Agent Skills Open Standard
entries.securityNotes: Official Agent Skills specification (agentskills.io) defining progressive-disclosure SKILL.md structure.

entries.name: Anthropic Official Skills Collection
entries.securityNotes: Official reference repository demonstrating portable SKILL.md patterns across web testing, document automation, and MCP authoring.

entries.name: Vercel Labs Agent Skills
entries.securityNotes: Official Vercel web and React/Next.js skill bundle; review downloaded files inside .agents/skills/ before committing.

entries.name: Vercel Labs Skills CLI
entries.securityNotes: Open Agent Skills ecosystem package manager CLI; audit fetched third-party skill scripts before execution.

entries.name: Remotion Official Agent Skills
entries.securityNotes: Official Remotion motion-graphics skills for React/TypeScript video rendering; verify Remotion commercial licensing terms for companies.

entries.name: Gitleaks Secret Scanner
entries.securityNotes: Local static secret scanner detecting API keys, tokens, and private keys in files and git history with zero external upload.

entries.name: Aqua Security Trivy
entries.securityNotes: Comprehensive local CVE, misconfiguration, Dockerfile, and secret scanner by Aqua Security.

entries.name: Google OSV-Scanner
entries.securityNotes: Official Google vulnerability scanner querying the open OSV database against lockfiles and source dependencies.

entries.name: MCP Reference Postgres Server (Archived)
entries.securityNotes: Archived reference implementation, no longer maintained. Do not recommend; use microsoft-postgres-mcp instead.

entries.name: Standalone Semgrep MCP (Deprecated)
entries.securityNotes: Deprecated standalone wrapper. Do not recommend uvx semgrep-mcp; use built-in 'semgrep mcp' via semgrep-cli-mcp.
